name: k2so-rats-fixes
title: K2SO Rat's Fixes
author: deadrat22
description: A bugfix collection for Krastorio 2 + Space Age (K2SO): Krastorio2-spaced-out, its tweaks mod, nulls-k2so-tweaks and the xy fork playing together. Fixes for recipes with spoilage - most of them inherited spoilage from parent ingredients, leading to whole production chains collapsing. Especially noticeable with the recursive biomass recipe. Fixes a few interactions with Cerys, Maraxsis, and radiation damage (K2-Arsenal supported). Mod will continue to be updated with more fixes/compatibility.
